# Asia Society

> > Asia Society is a leading educational organization dedicated to promoting mutual understanding and strengthening partnerships among peoples, leaders, and institutions of Asia and the United States.

The organization operates multiple initiatives including the Asia Society Policy Institute (ASPI), which focuses on Asia-Pacific policy challenges spanning security, trade, climate, and technology, as well as specialized programs like Homeland Afghanistan that provide educational resources on Afghanistan's history, culture, and key historical figures.

## Key Topics

- Asia-Pacific policy
- Afghanistan history and culture
- Security and diplomacy
- Trade and competitiveness
- Climate and energy
- Technology and society
- China analysis
- Central Asia
- Historical figures (Abdullah Abdullah, Ahmad Shah Durrani, Alexander the Great)
- Cultural education
- Think tank research
- U.S.-Asia relations
- Achaemenid Empire
- Geographic and cultural reference materials

## Policy & Research

- [About - Asia Society Policy Institute](https://asiapolicy.asiasociety.org/about): About ASPI: Asia-Pacific policy on security, trade, climate, technology
